1309-5232-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
1309-5232-8043.description:
Cast Clone Legion for free due to Vision, creating a token copy of each creature you control.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Salvager of Secrets token enters, it triggers, returning Clone Legion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

277-1018-5531-5694-8110.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {2}{C}{C}.
277-1018-5531-5694-8110.description:
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}{C}.
Cast Eldrazi Confluence by paying {2}{C}{C}, selecting its second mode three times, blinking Lumra, Skullwinder and Famished Worldsire.
As Famished Worldsire enters, choose to sacrifice at least the lands tapped for mana in step 1, causing Famished Worldsire to then enter with three +1/+1 counters for each land sacrificed.
When Lumra, Skullwinder and Famished Worldsire enter, they each trigger.
Resolve the Lumra trigger, causing you to mill four cards and return all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield
When the lands enter, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the lands.
Resolve the Skullwinder trigger, returning Eldrazi Confluence from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Famished Worldsire trigger, causing you to look at some cards from the top of your library and put any land cards from among them onto the battlefield
When the land(s) enter, Tiller Engine triggers that many times, untapping the land(s)
Repeat.
277-1018-5531-5694-8110.notes: If you can generate infinite {C} once you have all the lands on the battlefield, you can forego blinking Lumra and Famished Worldsire, and instead elect to blink Skullwinder and choose any two other modes from Eldrazi Confluence. This can allow you to blink other creatures, create infinite Eldrazi Spawn tokens and/or reduce any number of creatures' toughness to 0.

requires.battlefieldCardState: without a finality counter on it

4053-6495-7134--145.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a Villain without a finality counter on it.
When the Villain dies, Thunderbolts Conspiracy triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
4053-6495-7134--145.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1077-5571-6495--6.description:
Use Wrong Turn to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Evereth by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat from step 2.
1077-5571-6495--6.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1170-5131-5226-7054--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-5131-5226-7054--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Gravebreaker Lamia.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Lithatog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Lithatog +1/+1 until end of turn
Repeat.

3478-5414-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Dimir Aqueduct.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Dimir Aqueduct from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Troubled Healer ability
Repeat.

2173-3944-5220-7492.description:
Cast Blood Pet by paying its mana cost.
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it.
When Blood Pet dies, Mortuary and Arnyn trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Blood Pet from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Arnyn trigger, causing target opponent to lose 2 life and you to gain 2 life.
Cast Blood Pet from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1621-5998-6867-7055.description:
Cast Appa by paying {W}{W}
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

215-527-3480.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 6 or greater.
215-527-3480.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2558-2829-7422--109.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2558-2829-7422--109.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the 1/1 creature.
Garrison Excavator triggers. Holding priority, activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a 2/2 creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

2558-6798-7422--109.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2558-6798-7422--109.description:
Cause a 2/2 creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a 1/1.
Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the 1/1 creature.
Garrison Excavator triggers. Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a 2/2 creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

2043-2981-3621.description:
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard that is a 1/1 Soldier in addition to its other types.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token.
When the token Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, it triggers, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

2511-7084-7396.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

2713-3094-4659-7292-7344.easyPrerequisites: You have an artifact card in your graveyard.
2713-3094-4659-7292-7344.description:
Cast Brilliance Unleashed by paying {4}{U}{R}. Choose its second mode, targeting any artifact card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's second ability by paying {1} due to Zirda and tapping it, targeting Brilliance Unleashed.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Lithoform Engine, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Lithoform Engine ability, copying Brilliance Unleashed, targeting Lithoform Engine.
Resolve the copy of Brilliance Unleashed, returning Lithoform Engine from your graveyard to the battlefield as a 3/3 Robot artifact creature.
Repeat from step 2.

997-5687-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
997-5687-7084.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Skittering Precursor and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.
997-5687-7084.notes: You can instead sacrifice the creature tokens to their own abilities instead of sacrificing them to Woe Strider.

856-5147-5776-6351.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Teval trigger.
Resolve the Teval trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

339-677-4742-5256.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

30-141-5231.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
30-141-5231.description:
Cast Storm of Souls by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Storm of Souls.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Storm of Souls
Resolve the Storm of Souls copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
30-141-5231.notes: You can return any amount of creature cards with Storm of Souls as desired.

539-630-4657.easyPrerequisites: You control two mana-producing Forests, Mountains and/or Plains other than Magus of the Candelabra.
539-630-4657.description:
Activate two lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Keeper of Progenitus triggers twice, adding {2}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping the two lands and Magus of the Candelabra.
Repeat.

2957-3767-3918-4002.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
2957-3767-3918-4002.description:
Activate Imagecrafter by tapping it, causing Trazyn to become a Sliver until end of turn.
Activate Trazyn using Sceptre of Eternal Glory's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with power 4 or greater

81-1127-3152.description:
Activate Kami of Whispered Hopes by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}.
Cast Blinking Spirit by paying {3}{W}.
Chakram Retriever triggers, untapping Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Activate Blinking Spirit by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

465-719-3499-3742-4251.description:
Declare Phantom Steed and Godo as attackers, triggering each of their second abilities.
Resolve the Godo trigger, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Phantom Steed trigger, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the token Wormfang Drake enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, exiling Godo.
At the end of your combat phase, Phantom Steed triggers, causing you to sacrifice the Wormfang Drake token.
When the token Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield, its second ability triggers, returning Godo from exile to the battlefield.
When Godo enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, allowing you to search your library for an Equipment card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1558-4076-6441.notablePrerequisites:
You have a full party.
Burakos does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
1558-4076-6441.description:
Declare Burakos as an attacker.
Burakos triggers, creating eight Treasure tokens and causing the defending player to lose 4 life.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five Treasures, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

1806-2034-5997-6123.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
Eternal Scourge is exiled instead of being put into your graveyard due to Necrodominance.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Iraxxa triggers, creating a 2/2 Alien Warrior creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Alien Warrior and Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat from step 2.

2556-3617-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Time Walk and Mnemonic Wall each turn.
2556-3617-6122.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Mnemonic Wall by paying its mana cost.
When Mnemonic Wall enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Mnemonic Wall from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

2281-5754-5756.description:
Cast Phlage by paying {1}{R}{W}.
When Phlage enters the battlefield, its first and second abilities trigger.
Holding priority, activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Phlage.
When Saffi dies, Havi triggers, returning any legendary creature card with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Saffi ability.
Resolve the second Phlage trigger, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to gain 3 life.
Resolve the first Phlage trigger, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Phlage dies, Havi and Saffi trigger.
Resolve the Havi trigger, returning Saffi from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Saffi trigger, returning Phlage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

141-5788.description:
Cast Starfall Invocation by paying {3}{W}{W}, choosing to promise an opponent a gift.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Starfall Invocation.
Resolve Starfall Invocation, causing an opponent to draw a card, then destroying all creatures and returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

1408-2837-3259.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to another creature you control that does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1408-2837-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached as an attacker.
Dogmeat's second ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Cat creature token with haste due to Jinnie Fay.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Cat token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1606-3510-4875.notablePrerequisites:
Ley Weaver does not have summoning sickness.
"Saproling" chosen with Conspiracy.
1606-3510-4875.description:
Activate any land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping it and the land.
Repeat.

1087-1806-2034-2382.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, adding {C}{C}.
Eternal Scourge dies, triggering Mimic Vat, exiling Eternal Scourge.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Nalfeshnee triggers, creating a token copy of Eternal Scourge with haste.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Eternal Scourge token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

575-2994-4489-4871.description:
Cast Steelbane Hydra for {X} = 0.
Steelbane Hydra dies due to having zero toughness.
Yedora triggers, returning it to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate that Forest adding {G}.
Sacrifice the Treasure token for {G}.
Activate Primordial Mist by exiling the face-down Steelbane Hydra, and allowing you to cast it this turn.
Repeat.

1479-2907-3478.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-2907-3478.description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it, Scute Swarm, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Scute Swarm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dimir Aqueduct from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters the battlefield, it and Scute Swarm trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2034-2363-2399.notablePrerequisites: Hangarback Walker has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
2034-2363-2399.description:
Sacrifice Hangarback Walker to Ashnod's Altar, adding {C}{C}.
Hangarback Walker and Colfenor trigger.
Resolve the Hangarback Walker trigger, creating a Thopter token.
Resolve the Colfenor trigger with no targets.
Sacrifice the Thopter token to Ashnod's Altar, adding {C}{C}.
Colfenor triggers, returning Hangarback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Hangarback Walker for X=1.
Repeat.

3795-4067.description:
Activate Sea Gate Loremaster by tapping it, causing you to draw at least one card.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding a card, untapping Sea Gate Loremaster.
Repeat.
3795-4067.notes: This combo can net additional cards drawn each loop if you control more Allies.
